full_prompt_en: A square hand-drawn animation still shows a young cameraman crouching beside a large film camera in a dim teal industrial interior. The back of the room recedes through tall ribbed wall sections and an arched opening, while thick curved pipes cross the upper and middle background. A few small lamps and distant highlights glow through the cool haze. On the left, a dark camera body projects into the frame on a slender tripod; its round lens carries a warm amber reflection that contrasts with the surrounding blue-green metal. At center-right, a slim fair-haired young man squats close to the floor, facing the camera in profile. He wears a muted blue cap over short pale hair, a loose deep green hooded top, blue trousers, and brown shoes. His elbows bend near his knees and his hands hold a small dark object as he concentrates on the equipment. His long nose, clearly outlined eye, and simple mouth are drawn with expressive, economical shapes rather than photographic detail. The pale gray floor fills the lower part of the image, showing light scuffs, soft marks, and a dark contact shadow beneath his shoes. Behind him, the pipework and structural lines grow lighter and less distinct as they recede. Thin dark contours keep the foreground forms legible, while shaded color areas and softly brushed atmospheric texture give the setting depth. Warm light around the camera lens and a nearby wall lamp falls against the cooler ambient glow from above and behind, leaving the man's clothing in subdued shadow. The overall composition balances the heavy machine on the left with the compact crouching figure on the right, using teal space and restrained amber light for a quiet animated-film mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形手绘动画画面呈现一位年轻摄影师蹲在大型电影摄影机旁，置身昏暗的蓝绿色工业室内。房间后方由高大的竖肋墙体和一道拱形开口向深处延伸，粗弯管横过上方与中部背景。几盏小灯与远处的亮点透过冷色薄雾发光。左侧，深色摄影机架在细长三脚架上伸入画面；圆形镜头带有暖琥珀色反光，与周围蓝绿色金属形成对照。中央偏右，一位身形纤细、浅发色的青年靠近地面蹲着，侧身面向摄影机。他戴着柔和蓝色帽子，露出短浅色头发，穿宽松深绿色连帽上衣、蓝裤和棕色鞋子。他的手肘在膝旁弯曲，双手拿着一个深色小物件，注意力集中在设备上。细长的鼻子、轮廓清晰的眼睛和简洁的嘴以富有表情而节制的形状描绘，没有摄影式细节。浅灰地面占据画面下部，可见浅淡擦痕、柔软杂迹以及鞋下的深色接触影。身后管线与结构线向远处逐渐变浅、变得不那么清楚。细深色轮廓使前景形体容易辨认，带阴影的色块与轻轻刷开的空气肌理让环境有纵深。摄影机镜头和邻近壁灯周围的暖光与上方及后方的冷色环境光相映，使青年的衣服处于含蓄阴影中。整体构图以左侧厚重的机器平衡右侧紧凑的蹲姿，用蓝绿色空间和节制的琥珀光营造安静的动画电影气氛。
style_prompt_en: The image has the visual finish of a hand-drawn animation frame, with clean expressive outlines wrapped around softly shaded color masses. Deep teal and blue-green occupy broad areas, while small amber highlights create warm focal accents without overwhelming the cool range. Contours are firmer around near forms and loosen into hazy, lightly brushed distance, so depth comes from edge control as well as value. Flat painted passages retain faint grain and scuffed texture rather than becoming uniformly smooth. Curved linear rhythms cross quieter vertical structures, and a pale lower field gives the darker shapes a readable base. Gentle atmospheric light diffuses through the background while compact highlights and contact shadows anchor the foreground. The composition feels cinematic and subdued, with readable silhouettes held inside a spacious, cool-toned setting.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有手绘动画单帧的视觉完成感，干净而富于表情的轮廓包围着柔和明暗塑造的色块。深青与蓝绿色占据大面积，少量琥珀亮点形成温暖焦点，却不压过冷色范围。近处形体的边缘较硬，向远处逐渐松开，融入轻刷般的薄雾，因此纵深同时来自边缘控制和明度变化。平涂区域留有微弱颗粒与擦痕质感，而非通体均匀光滑。弧线节奏穿过较安静的竖向结构，浅色下部区域为深色形体提供清晰基底。柔和的空气光在背景中散开，紧凑高光和接触阴影则锚定前景。构图有电影感而克制，易读的剪影处于宽敞的冷色调空间中。
theme_en: An animated young cameraman crouching beside a film camera in a teal industrial interior
theme_zh: 蓝绿色工业室内里蹲在电影摄影机旁的动画青年
name: Animation
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
